It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

about_short_description.short_description: Alude is a database company that simplifies the process of buying and leasing of real-estate.

product.name: Análise de ficha
product.description: Provides instant credit and background reports using CPF or CNPJ to assess tenant or business risk.

product.name: Gestão de aluguel
product.description: Automates rental property management including billing, payment processing, fund transfers, and reporting.

product.name: Assinatura eletrônica
product.description: Enables legally valid electronic signing of real estate documents without requiring digital certificates.

product.name: Captação de imóveis
product.description: Collects and provides real-time contact information of property owners advertising in selected areas for acquisition or leasing.

product.name: Seguro residencial
product.description: Offers quick issuance of residential insurance policies, including fire insurance, directly through the platform.

product.name: Título de capitalização
product.description: Provides capitalization bonds to protect property owners during rental periods, with controlled redemption conditions.
